title: Looped Models are Fast Multi-Token Predictors
abstract: arXiv:2611.33896v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped language models can adapt computation for predicting a token without a proportional rescaling in unique model parameters by adjusting the number of loops. This property has been used for self-speculative decoding, taking shallow loops as fast drafters and deep loops as verifiers, which is effective since drafting still uses full parameters. In this paper, we show that shallow loops can be also predictive of several future tokens and leverage this to drastically accelerate the inference of looped language models. To that end, we present Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends a block of mask tokens as a suffix and learns via low-rank adaptation to draft these tokens in parallel. Across seven models, five benchmarks, a range of batch sizes, and both greedy and sampled decoding, Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most cases, attaining up to 7.5x acceleration. translated_title: 循环模型是快速的多词预测器
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型可以通过调整循环次数来适应预测一个词所需的计算量，而无需按比例缩放唯一的模型参数。这一特性已被用于自推测解码，将浅层循环作为快速起草者，深层循环作为验证者，这种方法之所以有效，是因为起草过程仍然使用完整参数。在本文中，我们证明浅层循环还可以预测多个未来词，并利用这一点来大幅加速循环语言模型的推理。为此，我们提出了Floodgates，一种简单的自推测解码方法，它在序列末尾附加一个掩码词块，并通过低秩适应学习并行起草这些词。在七个模型、五个基准测试、一系列批处理大小以及贪婪解码和采样解码的实验中，Floodgates在大多数情况下是最快的无损解码方法，实现了高达7.5倍的加速。通过分析，我们展示了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Floodgates自推测解码方法，在循环语言模型末尾附加掩码词块并通过低秩适应并行起草多个未来词，实现高达7.5倍的无损推理加速。
en_tdlr: Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends mask tokens to looped language models and uses low-rank adaptation to draft multiple future tokens in parallel, achieving up to 7.5x lossless inference acceleration.
